test_cases.title: Verify a logged-in user can add a single product to the shopping cart
preconditions: User is logged into the application
User is on the product listing or product details page
steps: Click the action to add the product to the shopping cart
Navigate to the shopping cart page
expected_result: The selected product is visible in the shopping cart

test_cases.title: Verify cart badge count increments when adding multiple products
preconditions: User is logged into the application
User is on the product listing page
steps: Add the first product to the shopping cart
Add a second different product to the shopping cart
expected_result: The cart badge displays '2' after the second product is added

test_cases.title: Verify user can proceed to checkout from the cart
preconditions: User is logged into the application
At least one product has been added to the shopping cart
User is on the shopping cart page
steps: Click the action to proceed to checkout
expected_result: The application navigates the user to the checkout interface
